texte.Fiecare aruncă 3 zaruri sub pahar și le: Everyone rolls 3 dice under a cup and sees only their own. Taking turns, you bid how many dice showing one face you think are on the whole table (for example “two dice showing 5”). The next player bids more dice, or the same number with a higher face, or calls “Liar!” Then the cups are lifted: if there are at least that many, the one who called loses a die; if not, the one who lied does. The last one left with dice wins.
